<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_snc_airop_check_definition"><x_snc_airop_check_definition action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><ai_justification><![CDATA[Sourcing negotiation volume indicates the frequency of supplier negotiations that Now Assist can assist with through document summarization, term analysis, and recommendation generation. Adequate negotiation volume maximizes AI impact on procurement outcomes.]]></ai_justification><check_name>Sourcing Negotiation Volume</check_name><check_script><![CDATA[(function(){
var ga=new GlideAggregate("sn_shop_negotiation");
ga.addAggregate("COUNT");ga.query();
var c=ga.next()?parseInt(ga.getAggregate("COUNT")):0;
if(c>=50)return{status:"ready",actualValue:c+" negotiations",finding:c+" negotiations found."};
if(c>0)return{status:"needs_attention",actualValue:c+" negotiations",finding:c+" negotiations found."};
return{status:"value_blocker",actualValue:"0 negotiations",finding:"No sourcing negotiations found."};
})()]]></check_script><is_active>true</is_active><is_clone_sensitive>false</is_clone_sensitive><is_manual>false</is_manual><module>SPO</module><number>CHK0001195</number><order/><remediation_guidance>Ensure sourcing negotiations are being conducted through SPO.</remediation_guidance><sys_class_name>x_snc_airop_check_definition</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-18 08:00:57</sys_created_on><sys_id>d3e736edcf21c7d48935fb251d851cc6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Sourcing Negotiation Volume</sys_name><sys_package display_value="ServiceNow AI Readiness Optimization Platform" source="x_snc_airop">73e2562fcf244b908935fb251d851c78</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="ServiceNow AI Readiness Optimization Platform">73e2562fcf244b908935fb251d851c78</sys_scope><sys_update_name>x_snc_airop_check_definition_d3e736edcf21c7d48935fb251d851cc6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-18 08:00:57</sys_updated_on></x_snc_airop_check_definition></record_update>
